metadata.name: Soft-fork enforcement dates on the invalid-block timelines
metadata.description: BIP16 uses a header timestamp threshold; other dates are the UTC header dates at the listed enforcement heights. SegWit and Taproot are included as later activations; this catalogue has no matching clusters of new-rule failures around those dates.
metadata.label_layout: BIP16 and BIP65 occupy the lower auto-label row to separate neighbouring activation labels at narrow widths. SegWit is top-aligned and Taproot bottom-aligned so the later labels sit away from the 2015 pair; full descriptions remain on hover.

annotations.label: BIP34: v2 rule
annotations.description: Height 224,413: version-2 blocks must encode their height in the coinbase (75% threshold).

annotations.label: BIP16
annotations.description: P2SH evaluation required for block timestamps >= 1333238400, 1 April 2012 UTC.

annotations.label: BIP34
annotations.description: Height 227,931: BIP34 coinbase height mandatory for every block (95% threshold).

annotations.label: BIP65
annotations.description: Height 388,381: OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY; block version below 4 rejected.

annotations.label: BIP66
annotations.description: Height 363,725: strict DER signatures; block version below 3 rejected.

annotations.label: SegWit
annotations.description: Height 481,824: Segregated Witness (BIP141); witness programs and block weight become consensus rules.

annotations.label: Taproot
annotations.description: Height 709,632: Taproot (BIP340/341/342); Schnorr and Tapscript spending rules become active.
